I know VOAT is having a hard time scaling due to the other site. One way voat can reduce the amount of work that the server needs to complete or process is to convert it to a single page application using angular, backbone or what have you.

The reason is that the client already has all the information they need to RENDER the page. they just need the content to render and thereby causing the backend to act as a "database" all it has to do is get the content and send it to the users. A lot of the work has already been done since voat already has a set of APIs that can be used.
It seems to be a good idea yes. But it means also an huge amount of work, it's like rebuilding everything, I don't think devs have time for that.
